summary: Strong TypeScript implementation with explicit types, proper async/await, and no gratuitous `any`. Workflow uses pinned refs (v4), least-privilege permissions (contents: read), and safe input routing through env. Code is well-factored: parsers reuse normaliseStatus and coerceDuration, aggregation extracts testKey and roundMillis, CLI separates parseArgs/collectInputFiles/loadRuns. Error messages include source context. Minor issue: top-level workflow env FIXTURE_DIR (line 18) is dead code, shadowed at step level (line 49). XML parser is necessary and well-commented but adds complexity. Testability is well-designed (main(argv) returns exit code, pure functions) but test files and fixtures are not shown (expected per "no tests" requirement). Deliverable depends on act validation and tests passing.
